comments.value: VRChat 2026.2.3p3 Build `1867` with the previous old UI was unaffected even while VRChat 2026.3.1 `Build 1885`'s new UI was live, so I believe this bug was introduced in VRChat 2026.3.1 `Build 1885` with the new UI and profile decorations.

details:
When your profile is set to use the avatar image as the bannerType in your profile, a banner of the current avatar photo doesn't get reliably updated or displayed in the client in many places after changing avatars.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Go to your profile, edit profile, set your profile banner type to avatar banner.

2. Close and restart the VRChat client, enter an instance with *Avatar 1*.

3. Open up Main Menu social tab, check the banner in "In Instance". You'll see *Avatar 1*.

4. Go to your profile, check the banner. You'll see *Avatar 1*.

5. "Edit Profile", check the banner. You'll see *Avatar 1*.

6. While editing your profile, click "Change Banner". You'll see *Avatar 1*.

7. Exit the menu and change your avatar in any way to *Avatar 2*. Wait for the avatar to finish loading.

8. Check steps 3-6 again. Instead of *Avatar 2*, you'll see *Avatar 1* in some places.

9. Wait some amount of time idle (5-10 minutes?).

10. Check steps 3-6 again. Instead of *Avatar 2*, you may still see *Avatar 1* in some places, but less than previously in step 8.

11. If you change the banner type to solid color and back to avatar photo, it may update immediately in some places, while staying stuck with *Avatar 1* in others.

Expected result: After changing avatars, show the currently worn avatar in the banner image everywhere in the UI.

Actual result:

- "In Instance" UI always displays the previous avatar banner (*Avatar 1*) you originally entered the instance with, not the current one. Rejoining the instance with another avatar (*Avatar 2*) worn does not update the banner shown here.

- "Edit Profile" may display a cached result your previous avatar in the banner for some amount of time.

- "Change Banner" may display a cached result your previous avatar in the banner for some amount of time, or it may display the current one even if "Edit Profile" displays an older one.

- The banner shown in your Main Menu profile is always the current avatar.

- The banner shown in Quick Menu on your profile is the current avatar.

Reproducible always and/or often.

This was an issue in Build `1903` too, but I was awaiting to see if the Build `1919` changes to social syncing were to fix this. It did not.
title: avatarBanner banner type image remains unchanged in "In Instance" UI and sometimes in "Edit Profile" or "Change Banner" after changing avatars
